description: LinguaScrape convergence (Python side) — ingest LinguaScrape's canonical nodes/edges export as a first-class acquisition source, reconcile its entities against existing Wikidata-sourced nodes, link its edges through the ontology, express its cross-domain correlations as shared Datalog rules, and load the merged corpus into Neo4j under shared labels/constraints — with QA gates and a reproducible build recipe.

userStories.title: LinguaScrape source adapter for the canonical export
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I need culture-scrape to ingest LinguaScrape's canonical nodes/edges TSV export so LinguaScrape becomes a first-class acquisition source.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an ingestion path (extend src/culturescrape/acquire/tabular.py or a thin acquire adapter) that reads the canonical nodes/*.tsv + edges/*.tsv export produced by LinguaScrape tasklist 15 into RawRecords, stamping provenance source='linguascrape'
Add a job spec jobs/linguascrape.yml describing the ingestion inputs and output_root
Read a committed fixture export under tests/fixtures/ (no coupling to a live filesystem path)
Tests pass (pytest), type checks pass (mypy), lint passes (ruff)

userStories.title: Canonical mapping & idempotent csid minting for LinguaScrape entities
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I need LinguaScrape rows mapped to the canonical schema with stable ids so re-runs are idempotent.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend src/culturescrape/schema/mapper.py (and schema/ids.py) to map LinguaScrape export columns to canonical node/edge fields per docs/data-model.md
Mint csid deterministically: prefer wikidata_qid when present, else derive from the LinguaScrape id alias so re-ingestion is idempotent
Retain the original LinguaScrape id as an alias column for round-trip
Tests assert idempotent csid derivation and correct column mapping on fixtures; mypy + ruff pass

userStories.title: Reconcile LinguaScrape entities against existing graph nodes
userStories.description: As a data steward, I need LinguaScrape entities merged with existing Wikidata-sourced nodes so the same entity is one node.
acceptanceCriteria: Parameterize src/culturescrape/schema/reconcile.py to run the cascade over LinguaScrape-origin records: iso639/glottocode for languages; normalized (name, type, region) for cultures/others; fuzzy fallback
Emit a reconciliation report (matched / new / ambiguous) with confidence; ambiguous candidates are listed and never auto-merged silently
Merges preserve both sources' provenance
Tests cover each cascade tier and the ambiguity path on fixtures; mypy + ruff pass

userStories.title: Ingest LinguaScrape edges into the ontology linker
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I need LinguaScrape's relationships to become canonical edges that participate in cross-dimensional linking.
acceptanceCriteria: Map LinguaScrape export edge :TYPE values to the canonical edge vocabulary and feed them through src/culturescrape/ontology/linker.py so temporal/geographic/linguistic/genetic linking includes them
LinguaScrape-origin edges carry time ranges, confidence, and provenance
src/culturescrape/ontology/metrics.py reports LinguaScrape edge counts by type
Tests assert edges load and link on fixtures; mypy + ruff pass

userStories.title: Datalog rules for LinguaScrape cross-domain correlations
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need LinguaScrape's correlation logic expressed as shared inference rules over the merged graph.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Datalog rules (src/culturescrape/datalog/rules.py + .pl/.dl outputs) porting LinguaScrape's cross-domain and genetic-linguistic correlation logic (e.g. genetic_linguistic_correlation/2, contemporary_with/2 across merged data, transitive descends_from)
Provide worked examples (src/culturescrape/datalog/examples.py) over a fixture corpus that includes LinguaScrape-origin facts
Exports valid Prolog (.pl) and Soufflé (.dl)
Tests validate rule output and derived facts on fixtures; mypy + ruff pass

userStories.title: Load the merged corpus into Neo4j under shared labels/constraints
userStories.description: As an integrator, I need LinguaScrape-origin nodes/edges loaded into Neo4j so the app can query them alongside native data.
acceptanceCriteria: src/culturescrape/neo4j/constraints.py ensures csid uniqueness per :LABEL for the merged corpus
src/culturescrape/neo4j/load_csv.py / admin_import.py load LinguaScrape-origin rows under the same labels and edge types as native nodes
A smoke test verifies the expected labels and edge types appear (mocked or embedded — no live server required in CI)
Tests + mypy + ruff pass

userStories.title: Convergence QA gate for the merged corpus
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need QA thresholds so LinguaScrape ingestion cannot silently degrade the corpus.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend src/culturescrape/orchestrate/qa.py to report provenance completeness, dedup rate, unreconciled rate for LinguaScrape-origin rows, and dangling-edge rate
The gate exits non-zero on regressions beyond configured thresholds
Emit a human-readable QA report artifact
Tests cover a clean corpus (pass) and a degraded corpus (fail); mypy + ruff pass

userStories.title: Reproducible build recipe & convergence docs
userStories.description: As a contributor, I need a documented, reproducible way to (re)build the LinguaScrape-inclusive corpus.
acceptanceCriteria: jobs/linguascrape.yml (and/or a blueprint) drives an end-to-end `culturescrape run` producing the merged corpus deterministically
Document the flow (ingest -> reconcile -> link -> Datalog/Neo4j) in packages/culture-scrape/docs/ and cross-link docs/culturescrape-integration.md at the repo root
The built corpus stays gitignored; a committed manifest records node/edge type counts
`culturescrape validate` and `culturescrape qa` pass on the output; mypy + ruff pass
